name: Everyday task matching: synthetic v1
notes: Forty hand-written everyday cases: 20 clear no-matches, 16 genuine matches, two ambiguity and two missing-context diagnostics. Each partition has 10/8/1/1. Plans and their conversations stay in one group and split. Scope labels treat tasks as broad attention areas. These are synthetic examples for comparing useful links against correction cost, not a zero-error release gate or representative work validation.
